title.zh: 归一化、残差与梯度尺度

en.a: Normalization and residual placement determine how an attention/FFN block writes into the residual stream and how depth changes the backward scale.
en.b: The residual stream is still a conditional representation; normalization changes the coordinates in which each conditional read and gradient is parameterized, not the causal factorization.

zh.a: 归一化和残差位置决定了注意力/前馈块如何写入残差流，以及深度如何改变反向传播的尺度。
zh.b: 残差流仍然是一种条件表示；归一化改变了每个条件读取和梯度的参数化坐标，而非因果分解。
